sourceRules.silence: A value SmashWiki does not state for Ultimate is {status: SOURCE_SILENT}. Older-game numbers are never promoted to Ultimate values; they may appear inside a SOURCE_SILENT note only.
sourceRules.ufd: UltimateFrameData has no item pages (https://ultimateframedata.com/items -> 404; character pages list no item rows, see DK items-taunts audit). Every value here is SmashWiki.
sourceRules.native: Native game data (WuBoytH SSBU-Dumped-Scripts / Motion-Lists, prcFighterParam) is supporting only and is not used as a value source here.
sourceRules.quoteFormat: sourceQuote is verbatim wikitext. 'Row | Column | cell' = a table cell. ' || ' or ' / ' joins several verbatim excerpts from the cited page(s). 'scope' notes wording that is not explicitly Ultimate-scoped. 'conflict' records disagreements and their resolution.

headlineFindings: Fan is NOT in Ultimate (infobox games SSB/Melee/Brawl only; no item_harisen motion in DK or Pikachu native motion lists). Needs a user decision: drop from the first pass.

Battering items replace only neutral attack, forward tilt, dash attack and forward smash (Item page). Up/down tilt, up/down smash and aerials with a battering item are SOURCE_SILENT, i.e. the fighter's own moves remain.

Home-Run Bat: Ultimate damages jab 7 / ftilt 13 / dash 16 / fsmash 30; fsmash swing timing 51 frames for all characters; fsmash is a fixed (uncharged) swing except the Ultimate reflect-interrupt rule.
Almost all frame data (startup/active/FAF), angles, BKB and KBG for items are SOURCE_SILENT on SmashWiki.
Bob-omb fuse/walk timers, Fire Flower per-flame damage, Star Rod damage, Golden Hammer numbers, Crate/Barrel HP and explosion damage, and every idle despawn time are SOURCE_SILENT for Ultimate.
